name: AiInlineSuggestion
purpose: An input or textarea with an optional proposed suffix that the user explicitly accepts or dismisses.
description: Offer a proposed field value while keeping acceptance under user control.

props.name: suggestion
props.description: Full proposed value, including the already typed prefix.

guidance.overview: An input or textarea with an optional proposed suffix that the user explicitly accepts or dismisses.
usage: Supply a suggestion that extends the current value. A mismatched suggestion does not replace the entered text.
Accepting changes the value; merely displaying the suggestion does not. Keep the suggestion concise and relevant to the current field.
Use Field for label, helper text, and validation so generated assistance remains part of the normal form.
accessibility: Tab accepts a matching visible suffix, Escape dismisses it, and the next Tab leaves the field normally.
A visible Accept button provides an alternative to the shortcut, and the suggestion is described through a polite status.
intent: AI styling marks the proposed text as assistance; acceptance is a local edit, not validation of its correctness.
context: Use for draft titles, descriptions, and other short text completions with a clear review opportunity.
